availability.steady-state: unavailable_incomplete_debounce_window until two consecutive candidate samples establish the initial state
availability.structure-unstable: unavailable_no_predecessor without an immediately preceding complete sample; unavailable_steady_state when its steady-state prerequisite is unavailable

rules.steady-state: A debounced state over complete consecutive fixed-step samples. A candidate is stable exactly when every dynamic body has squared linear speed at most 0.0001 and absolute angular speed at most 0.01 degrees/second. The candidate must persist for two fixed steps before the state is established or changes; every post-initial change must match a same-step engine stability event.
rules.structure-unstable: Available only with an immediately preceding complete fixed-step sample and an available steady-state label; true exactly when steady-state is false and the directed engine support-relation set differs from the predecessor.
